name: Brown & Brown, Inc.

corporate_actions.event: Completed acquisition of Accession Risk Management Group (Risk Strategies, One80 Intermediaries), ~$9.83bn

geography.fx_notes: Geographic disclosure: US, UK and Other; US is the large majority (>80%, INFERENCE - exact % not extracted).

kpis.name: Q3-26 organic by segment: Retail / Specialty Distribution

acquisitions.earnouts: Change in estimated earn-out payables: +$27m expense Q3-26, $(7)m benefit 9M-26; escrow liability MTM benefit $(83)m 9M-26 (S2). Liability balance not extracted.
acquisitions.notes: Accession ~$9.83bn (~$4bn equity, ~$4bn new debt). Implied ~16x adj EBITDAC using reported ~$1.7bn revenue and ~36.7% margin - ESTIMATE, not a company multiple.

management.succession_notes: Brown family-led; succession plan not reviewed
management.guidance_record: Guided improved organic for 2026 in Jan-2026 (S4) but Q2-26 organic negative and Q3-26 only 1.2% (S3) - miss vs expectation

ownership.controlling_holders: Brown family (J. Hyatt Brown and family) significant but non-controlling holders - % not extracted

evidence: Organic swung from +10.4% (2024) to +2.8% (2025) to negative (Q4-25 -2.8%, Q2-26) (S5,S4,S3)
Specialty Distribution (wholesale/programs/MGA) exposed to cat property rates and contingents (S3)
A.rationale: Retail is recurring, but Specialty/MGA revenue proved more volatile than peers.

evidence: Competition from admitted carriers pulling accounts out of E&S hit Specialty Distribution (S3)
B.rationale: Decentralised culture is a strength but specialty programmes lack durable pricing power in a soft market.

C.rationale: Best-in-class margin evidences scale/cost discipline, though now declining.

evidence: Accession adds ~$1.7bn revenue and specialty MGA scale (S6)
D.rationale: Runway via M&A; organic runway currently weak.

evidence: Segments US / UK / Other with US large majority (S1)

F.rationale: Experienced team, but recent operating misses.

G.rationale: Large deal at a high multiple; leverage kept ~3.2x.

evidence: Retail mix includes personal lines and small commercial; wholesale/MGA placement (S1)
I1.rationale: Small-account and personal lines more exposed to digital/embedded distribution (INFERENCE).

evidence: Specialty Distribution organic -0.8% Q3-26, -7.8% Q4-25 on property cat rate declines (S3,S4)
J.rationale: Above-average exposure to the property pricing cycle and contingent commissions.

evidence: Earn-out and escrow MTM swings through P&L (S2)

sector_specific.organic_ex_rate_note: INFERENCE: BRO had the highest rate leverage among US brokers (cat property programmes, flood claims processing, wholesale). Organic fell from 10.4% (2024) to 2.8% (2025) and ~1% (2026); management cites soft property/specialty pricing and admitted carriers pulling E&S accounts - i.e. most of the 2023-24 organic premium was rate-driven.
sector_specific.contingent_consideration: Earn-out payable P&L change +$27m Q3-26 / -$7m 9M-26; balance not extracted (S2)
sector_specific.producer_retention: Q4-25 call flagged 'talent poaching risk' (Coverager, not used as primary)

gates.notes: G1: ~3.2x PitchBook (company debt ~$7.76bn / EBITDA $2.5bn ~3.1x) < 4.0x. G4 not computed here.

bull_points: Industry-leading ~35% EBITDAC margin and decentralised culture; Accession adds specialty scale and diversifies.
Organic at cyclical trough; property rate declines eventually lap.
bear_points: Organic growth collapsed from 10.4% to ~1% - evidence that much prior growth was rate-driven.
Specialty Distribution losing E&S flow to admitted carriers; margins down 200bp.
Large Accession deal at ~16x (ESTIMATE) closed near the top of the cycle.
thesis_breakers: Adj EBITDAC margin < 33% for a full year.
